daily_closed_loop.scope_of_duration: Actions job elapsed time, not measured ECS CPU time or billed spend

findings.finding: Daily discovery schedule is not gated by the current C2 project stage or family terminal result before heavy work.
findings.evidence: Five scheduled jobs, visible repeated terminal decisions, 186.65 total job minutes; carry and cross-venue metrics unchanged but information-set metrics changed.

findings.finding: Public closed-loop annotation is unbounded and real output is incomplete.
findings.evidence: All five public messages end at 4096 characters; synthetic allowed-size error/tail fixture emits 5153 bytes.

findings.finding: C2 research replay exists, but four historical proof-class verifiers are unsupported.
findings.evidence: historical_verification_supported remains false by declared capability, not a data-dependent test waiting to turn green.

findings.finding: Successful scheduled jobs and old Smoke do not prove current Demo runtime or account health.
findings.evidence: Default research action skips registration/activation/restart; last Smoke completed 2026-09-13T13:26:10Z. No direct runtime snapshot this review.

findings.finding: SSH trust configuration differs across workflows and helper scripts.
findings.evidence: REST accepts secret or variable and requires a pinned key; legacy action reads secret only, some helpers make pinning optional and trust all scanned host keys. Actual secret/variable placement is not inspected.

findings.finding: Research model validation, historical factual certification and execution permission need separate machine-readable exits.
findings.evidence: Counterfactual orders cannot have fabricated real account records; a separately approved bounded model is not a historical-fact or trading authorization.

findings.finding: Separate REST L1 sampling and public ob200 archive cannot restore the frozen intermediate states.
findings.evidence: Two source-bound REST cross sequences strictly between events; exact same-archive recovery path already closed.

limitations: No direct ECS process/account/disk inspection this turn
Public closed-loop annotations are truncated; full private artifact not downloaded
Source identity and numerical checks are not profitability certification
Roundtable is a single-reviewer structured internal review
Pipeline source reviewed selectively with full regression, not a whole-repository security certification

proposal_only.batch_a: Convergent scheduling, complete bounded reports, unified SSH trust, fresh read-only runtime inventory
proposal_only.batch_b: Freeze factual-vs-model acceptance contract and implement independently verifiable evidence capabilities
proposal_only.batch_c: Versioned coherent market-data capture and one bounded validation problem; no new strategy promotion before required gates
